CESM2-FV2 (2019): 
aerosol: MAM4 (same grid as atmos)
atmos: CAM6 (1.9x2.5 finite volume grid; 144 x 96 longitude/latitude; 32 levels; top level 2.25 mb)
atmosChem: MAM4 (same grid as atmos)
land: CLM5 (same grid as atmos)
landIce: CISM2.1
ocean: POP2 (320x384 longitude/latitude; 60 levels; top grid cell 0-10 m)
ocnBgchem: MARBL (same grid as ocean)
seaIce: CICE5.1 (same grid as ocean)
